jobs.title: Product Manager E-Invoicing (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Warum Wir?

Bei uns erwarten Dich weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams, flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur, die zum Mitgestalten einlädt. Mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören für uns zum Alltag. Möchtest Du Teil eines innovativen Unternehmens werden, dessen Lösung den Arbeitsalltag in unterschiedlichsten Branchen digitalisiert? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams!


Das erwartet Dich

Als Product Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest Du die Anbindung von DocuWare an Netzwerke zum Austausch von e-Invoices in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, UX- und Compliance-Spezialisten. Gemeinsam stellt Ihr sicher, dass DocuWare die Anforderungen unserer Kunden an den Austausch von elektronischen Rechnungen erfüllt. Dabei behältst Du die regulatorischen Anforderungen und Zeitpläne im Blick und hilfst unseren Kunden, diese mit DocuWare zu erfüllen. 

Du kannst dich in die Lage unserer Anwenderinnen und Anwender versetzen und ihre Probleme und täglichen Aufgaben nachvollziehen? Du bist neugierig, arbeitest gerne lösungsorientiert und im Team, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und bist ein Organisationstalent? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennen zu lernen! 
Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Du verfolgst die Entwicklungen und Anforderungen für e-Invoicing in und außerhalb Europa in Zusammenarbeit mit externen und internen Compliance-Spezialisten.
  • Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Anforderungen und Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden.
  • Du agierst dabei kundenzentriert, holst Kundenfeedback ein und analysierst Daten, um die richtigen Entscheidungen abzuleiten.
  • Du formulierst präzise Anforderung zu den Kundenproblemen und -bedürfnissen.
  • Du entwirfst die kurz-, mittel- und langfristige Strategie und Roadmap für Deinen Bereich unseres Produkts und führst das Team mit Zielen und KPIs.
  • Du prägst eine konstruktive und integrative Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Produktteams und agierst als Teamschnittstelle zu Stakeholdern.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Softwareentwicklern und UX-Spezialisten an der Implementierung des Produktes im Rahmen des SCRUM-Frameworks zusammen.


Das bringst Du mit

  • Du verfügst über breites und tiefes Wissen im Bereich e-Invoicing.
  • Die Begriffe XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, FatturaPA und Factur-X sind für Dich keine Unbekannten.
  • Du kannst die Unterschiede zwischen PEPPOL, SDI, Chorus Pro und FACe in wenigen Worten verständlich erklären.
  • Du hast Erfahrung als Produktmanager für Software-Produkte. Erfahrung mit B2B Software ist ein Plus.
  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem agilen Umfeld (beispielsweise als SCRUM Product Owner).
  • Du hast Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Endnutzern und der Lösungsgestaltung anhand deren Bedürfnissen.
  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten, arbeitest zielorientiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.
  • Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich darzulegen.
  • Eine Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Teamfähigkeit zeichnen Dich aus.
  • Fließende Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.


Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

Es gibt viele gute Gründe für DocuWare – unsere Unternehmenskultur ist nur einer davon.
 Im Team von DocuWare profitierst auch Du von diesen Vorteilen:

  • Weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams: Du triffst uns in Germering, New York, Sofia oder vielen anderen Locations.
  • Flexibler Arbeitsort und Arbeitszeit: Du arbeitest mobil oder in unserem modernen und gut ausgestattetem Büro – dabei teilst Du Dir deine Arbeitszeit flexibel ein.
  • Individuelle Förderung: Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung bekommst Du regelmäßig auf Dich zugeschnittene Weiterbildungen (u.a. Kongresse, interne Teambuilding Maßnahmen).
  • Wohl verdiente Erholung: Neben 35 Urlaubstagen im Jahr bieten wir Dir ein breites Sport- und Massageangebot, Kicker-Tisch und einen entspannenden Lounge-Bereich.
  • Gesunde Ernährung: Zusammen genießen wir Fairtrade Kaffee mit Bio-Milch oder HaferDrink, Snacks und frisches Obst – alles kostenlos – sowie bezuschussten Lunch aus dem Foodji-Kühlschrank. 
  • Team-Spirit: Regelmäßige Events für Mitarbeitende - virtuell oder vor Ort sorgen für Zusammenhalt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit und soziales Engagement: DocuWare steht für papierloses Arbeiten und unterstützt ehrenamtliche Organisationen und lokale Sportvereine.
  • Gute Erreichbarkeit auf allen Wegen: Komm ins Büro mit dem geleasten E-Bike (Jobrad), per S-Bahn oder über die Autobahnen A96/A99 (Dein E-Auto kannst Du vor Ort kostenlos laden).
  • Du sorgst vor & wir unterstützen Dich dabei: DocuWare bezuschusst Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
  • Ein stabiler Arbeitsplatz: In unserem langjährig bestehenden und stetig wachsenden Unternehmen erhältst Du eine unbefristete Festanstellung.
  • Wir nutzen immer die neuesten Technologien: Erfahre mehr auf Stackshare.
  • Einzigartige Vorteile: Wähle eine von drei großartigen Optionen (Bonago, E-Gym oder Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets) nach Deinen Bedürfnissen.
  • 30 Tage Work from Abroad: Erlebe internationale Erfahrungen und erweitere Deinen Horizont.
  • Family First: Bevorzugte Anmeldung in unserer ausgewählten Kindertagesstätte in Germering (keine Garantie).
  • Buddy Programm: Du erhältst einen Buddy, der Dir den Einstieg erleichtert und Dich in Deinen ersten Wochen bei DocuWare unterstützt.
Für noch mehr Einblicke, schau doch gerne auf unserem Instagram vorbei!


Kontaktperson

Chiara Drechsel 
Team Lead Recruiting & Employer Branding

jobs.description:
Product Owner Softwareentwicklung (m/w/d)

Bei unserem namhaften Kunden im Raum Aalen - einem führenden Unternehmen der Hightechindustrie - bietet sich diese einmalige Perspektive im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung mit der Option auf Übernahme.

Dein zukünftiger Tätigkeitsbereich

  • Die Product-Vision einer anspruchsvollen Software für die Produktion von optischen High-Tech Systemen zusammen mit dem Scrum-Team weiterentwickeln

  • Die Entwicklung eines oder mehrerer Softwareprodukte im Umfeld komplexer Produktionsprozesse verantworten

  • Die Einführung von Softwareprodukten in der Produktion durchführen und als Ansprechpartner bei Problemen fungieren

Das zeichnet Dich aus 

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium Informatik (m/w/d), alternativ ein naturwissenschaftliches oder ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium oder vergleichbar

  • Erfahrung in der Leitung von Softwareprojekten, der Analyse von Anforderungen und fundierte Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung

  • Erfahrung in der Mitarbeit in agilen Teams sowie Erfahrung in der Rolle als Product Owner

  • Ein hohes Prozessverständnis und die Fähigkeit komplexe Probleme einfach zu abstrahieren (z.B. mittels Diagramme)

  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (B2)

Deine berufliche Zukunft

  • Vergütung: Übertarifliche Bezahlung zuzüglich Branchenzuschläge

  • Work-Life-Balance: Uns ist die Vereinbarkeit von Job und Familie sehr wichtig, daher sind 30 Tage Urlaub und ein Gleitzeitkonto selbstverständlich

  • Karriere bei Top Unternehmen: Freue dich auf langfristige Einsätze bei renommierten Unternehmen der Region mit echter Übernahmeoption!

  • Mitarbeiter-Benefits: Profitiere von betrieblichen Zusatzleistungen wie Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld, bezuschusste betriebliche Altersvorsorge und VWL

  • Wachsendes Unternehmen: Mit starkem Auftragseingang und Dynamik

  • Firmenveranstaltungen: Freu Dich auf das traditionelle jährliche encontec-Standortfest

  • Persönliche Betreuung: Dein persönlicher Ansprechpartner steht Dir jederzeit zur Seite und kümmert sich um all Deine Anliegen

Stellendetails

Arbeitsort: Oberkochen  
Arbeitszeit: 40-Stunden-Woche

Vertragsart: Arbeitnehmerüberlassung

Dauer: 12 Monate

Startdatum: sofort oder nach Absprache

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Operations (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
JOIN OUR TEAM

As a Senior Product Manager, you will join our Technology team to drive the efficiency of Westwing's supply chain and fulfilment operations across Europe. Operating at the intersection of business and technology, you will partner with senior stakeholders to translate operational strategy into scalable systems across warehouse, order, and delivery management. Having recently completed a major migration of our order and warehouse management systems to modern SaaS platforms, we are now transitioning from initial stabilisation to building the next generation of scalable capabilities on top of that foundation. In this high-impact role, you will directly drive operational excellence and cost efficiency by shaping the systems that power our end-to-end processes, from initial sourcing to final customer delivery. This position is permanent and based in Munich.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Partner with stakeholders across Sourcing, Logistics, Warehouse, and Operations to own the roadmap for our Supply Chain and Fulfilment systems, spanning both SaaS platforms and in-house tools
  • Own and drive measurable business outcomes aligned with company OKRs and operational performance targets, translating operational needs into clear functional specifications and defining KPIs for data-led optimisation
  • Coordinate the implementation of new and existing capabilities with our SaaS vendors and integration partners, driving delivery through to rollout
  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for in-house operational tools, from prioritisation and delivery to continuous improvement, working closely with engineering, data, and design teams to ensure high-quality, scalable, and timely delivery
  • Drive product discovery to identify automation and optimisation opportunities, leveraging AI and emerging technologies to innovate across the supply chain
  • Make build-versus-buy decisions based on speed, scalability, and long-term impact, helping shape our evolving strategy across SaaS and in-house tooling as AI lowers the cost of custom software


YOU COME WITH

  • 5+ years of product management experience within e-commerce, retail, or logistics, with a solid understanding of fulfilment and warehouse operations and systems such as OMS, WMS, or ERP
  • Proven track record of implementing, configuring, and integrating SaaS solutions, with a strong comfort level blending product ownership with hands-on vendor and implementation coordination
  • Extensive experience in project management, business analysis, Agile methodologies, and leading cross-functional teams to drive continuous process improvements
  • Comfort with Excel and SQL, combined with practical experience using AI tools to accelerate research, documentation, and prototyping
  • Strong analytical mindset with a passion for using data to distinguish between what technically works and what truly scales
  • Fluency in English paired with excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders across all functional and management levels
  • High resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities


WHY WESTWING

If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it.
At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living.

Here is what you can look forward to:

• A high-performance culture built on trust, feedback and collaboration
• An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone
• A flexible hybrid setup with 3 office days per week - because strong connections and quick collaboration make great ideas happen
• Work-from-anywhere opportunities for up to 4 weeks per year - as fresh perspectives spark bold ideas
• 30 days of paid holiday to rest, recharge, and come back ready to create
• A beautiful, centrally located, dog-friendly office with inspiring spaces, a sunny terrace, and good food - designed for moments that energise and connect
• Exclusive discounts - 40% off Westwing Collection, 20% off third-party brands (each on non-reduced items), 10% Family & Friends discount, plus special-occasion vouchers
• Wellbeing support through mental health resources, sports memberships, and preventive care
• Sustainable mobility options with discounted public transport and JobRad - moving with purpose and care for the planet
• Support for working parents, including our on-site Westwing Wichtel daycare and a partnership with multilingual provider Elly & Stoffl
• One annual Social Impact Day to give back to a cause you care about - because being human is our true superpower
• Team rituals that celebrate results and togetherness - from Summer & Winter Parties to Oktoberfest


ABOUT US

Westwing, Europe’s #1 in Beautiful Living e-commerce, is present in 20+ European countries and achieved a GMV (Gross Merchandise Volume) of EUR 507 million in 2025. As Europe’s premium one-stop destination for Design Lovers, it offers a unique brand experience with a carefully curated assortment of the Westwing Collection and 3rd party design brands. The integrated platform combines Shop, Daily Specials, Stores, the B2B Service (Westwing Business) and the Westwing Design Service. Westwing’s team works together on its shared purpose to “Excite people to create homes that unlock the full beauty of life”. Founded in 2011, Westwing is headquartered in Munich and went public on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in October 2018.

Our team is a diverse group of professionals aiming for high performance, working together at a fast pace in an inspiring, international and informal environment that enables you to grow your career while working with a brand and products our customers love. We’re made up of passionate people who are creative enough to disrupt the status quo, brave enough to fail and smart enough to win. So come, be part of the “wow, you work at Westwing?” crowd.

Diversity is deeply rooted in our culture. Our mission doesn’t stop to inspire only your design choices, it continues to embrace an inclusive lifestyle filled with respect to everyone’s uniqueness, cultural differences and equal opportunity.

Senior Product Manager – German Speaking - Managed Detection and Incident Response (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 190 FTEs and continue to grow internationally having secured our Series C funding of €60 Million!

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds — all united by a shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

At Eye, you'll work on projects with an international footprint, solving real-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.

About this role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager – Managed Detection and Incident Response (m/f/x) to join our Product team.

As our client base continues to grow rapidly across Europe, this role will play a key part in scaling our Managed Detection and Response (MDR), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), and Incident Response (IR) capabilities — Eye Security's most strategic product area.

You'll take full ownership of the product strategy and roadmap for this space. Collaborating with our engineers, product designers, security operations, and product marketing, you will ensure that our platform evolves with our customers' needs and delivers maximum impact.

This is a senior individual contributor role designed for someone who thrives on autonomy, discovery, and leading cross-functional product development in a fast-growing environment.

What you will do

  • Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for MDR, EDR, and IR, ensuring alignment with our overall product vision and company OKRs.

  • Drive discovery practices to deeply understand customer needs, problems, and pain points, translating them into actionable solutions and product opportunities.

  • Work closely with Engineering, Product Design, Security Operations, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales teams to deliver successful outcomes.

  • Partner with Product Marketing to define go-to-market plans and deliver clear, compelling product launches.

  • Manage external relationships, especially with EDR vendors and MDR technology providers, ensuring alignment with our MSP and partner ecosystem.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our internal processes, tooling, and product culture, helping Eye Security scale sustainably.

  • Stay up to date with cybersecurity trends, emerging technologies, and industry best practices to drive innovation and maintain competitive advantage.

What you will need

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 2 years in a senior role owning end-to-end delivery of software products in B2B SaaS or similar environments.

  • Deep understanding of cybersecurity principles and best practices, especially in Managed Detection & Response (MDR), Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), and Incident Response (IR).

  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex software products in a fast-paced environment, using product discovery and data-driven decision making.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.

  • Experience working in an agile development environment.

  • Fluent English; German language (C2) is required

Nice-to-have

  • Startup or scale-up background at a high-growth company.

  • Experience building or scaling product management teams and processes.

  • Exposure to OKR-driven product development and metrics-focused product management.

  • Experience working with MSP or partner-led go-to-market models.

  • Track record of navigating successful product pivots or strategic repositioning.

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission: protect organizations across Europe from real-world cyber threats.

  • Work with top-tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds.

  • Full strategic ownership of a mission-critical product area in a high-growth cybersecurity scale-up.

  • Mentorship and growth: lead and develop the next generation of product managers; grow into broader strategy and leadership roles.

  • A remote-friendly culture with quarterly meetups and annual company retreats (in Spain, Portugal, Italy…).

  • Weekly lunches (NL) and Thursday socials to stay connected.

  • A generous time-off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including equity participation.

Are you up for it?

We look forward to receiving your application.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to making our hiring process accessible to everyone. If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply or interview for this role, please inform the TA team.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (Product Manager)
jobs.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We're building a larger, dedicated Platform team at Lendable, increasing our investment in the infrastructure that enables our products and engineering teams to scale.

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to sit within Engineering and connect platform technology, reliability and commercial value. You'll own what we prioritise and why, giving engineers the business context they need while helping Product and leadership understand the impact and opportunities that Platform enables.

This is a hands-on technical IC role, where you'll stay close to engineering through writing code, reviewing PRs and contributing to architecture discussions.

Working closely with the Platform Engineering Manager and Tech Lead, you'll help shape the Platform roadmap, connect technical investment to measurable business outcomes, and build the foundations that allow Lendable to move faster and scale with confidence.

What you'll be doing

Own platform stability

  • Own platform stability as a primary accountability - SLA/SLO metrics, incident rates, release quality.

  • Hold release gating authority: block features from production that don't meet testing standards or introduce unacceptable regression risk.

  • Enforce CI/CD standards centrally so pods don't fragment into one-off solutions.

  • Track and report stability metrics alongside commercial outcomes - stability is the foundation that makes the rest possible.

Be commercially accountable

  • Own the business case for platform investment and answer "why are we spending six engineers on this for three months?" in terms leadership understands.

  • Track platform impact in business terms: developer velocity, incident cost, time-to-market, reliability, capacity - e.g. "CXO rollout removes a 3-second API fan-out, reducing session abandonment" or "we can now handle 20k simultaneous logins".

  • Input into headcount and investment decisions for the platform team.

Own the platform roadmap

  • Own the platform backlog, prioritised by business value and sequenced to unblock the highest-value product teams first - not driven by technical debt or engineer preference alone.

  • Make trade-offs explicit: "if we do X now, we defer Y by Z weeks - here's what that means for products depending on us".

  • Ensure every initiative has a defined success metric that non-engineers can track.

Be the stakeholder interface

  • Act as the single point of contact for Pod Leads: business requirements coming from pods and engineering/developer requirements flowing to pods; prioritise both in service of platform stability.

  • Make platform work visible to leadership - regular forums with product MDs and PMs to capture upcoming dependencies before they become blockers; represent platform work in leadership reviews; translate technical milestones into business milestones.

  • Drive cross-team collaboration and buy-in with other PMs; engage architecture in technical design.

  • Escalate when product teams make requests that would create unsustainable platform load or technical debt.

Contribute as an engineer

  • Write code, review PR's, and participate in architecture design as a core part of the role - not a side project.

  • Bring a strong technical voice to roadmap decisions without owning final architecture calls (that's Architecture and Tech Leads).

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Deep, hands-on engineering background - this role must be staffed by someone who has shipped production systems, not someone who has only managed backlogs.

  • Strong commercial instinct: can build a business case, speak to P&L impact, and hold a line on ROI.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management across product, engineering, and finance without direct line authority over all of them.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity - platform value is often indirect and long-horizon.

  • Track record of contributing as an IC while operating at a senior, cross-team level.

  • Proactive, low-ego, and clear communicator - able to hold a line with leadership and pod leads alike.

Nice to have

  • Experience in platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling contexts.

  • Familiarity with SLA/SLO frameworks and incident management at scale.

  • Experience enforcing CI/CD standards across multiple teams or pods.

  • Prior work making "invisible" infrastructure legible to non-technical leadership.

Our tech stack

Platform & backend: Kotlin, AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Gateway & clients: Node GraphQL gateway, React Native / TypeScript mobile app, Relay.

Tooling & observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.

Interview process

  • Quick call with the Talent Team (30 minutes)

  • Hiring manager interview (30 minutes)

  • Technical and Product interview (90 minutes)

  • Culture-add interview (60 minutes)

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to design and shape our product. This is a rare opportunity to join early on. You’ll be joining a small but mighty team that genuinely loves helping each other grow. We believe deeply in craft, collaboration, and improving the status quo in an industry that's been overlooked for far too long.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own a product area: you’ll take charge of designing key flows in Raft’s logistic platform.

  • Drive a full end-to-end design process: from user research and journey mapping through to wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and handoff.

  • Advocate for users and bring clarity to complex workflows in a fast-moving environment.

  • Shape our design culture: collaborate with other designers who care deeply about craft, mentoring, and shipping great work.

 

You should apply if you...

  • Have strong experience designing B2B SaaS platforms, especially ones with complex workflows or enterprise users.

  • Have a solid craft, creating designs that are well thought through and visually pleasing.

  • Love getting into the messy middle — researching, simplifying, iterating, and polishing.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity: shaping problems, identifying opportunities, and working without a detailed spec.

  • Communicate clearly and confidently, especially when collaborating with engineers or presenting to stakeholders.

  • Enjoy taking initiative, and owning your work.

  • Want to join a team that balances high standards with low ego.

 

This role might not be for you if...

  • You’re just focused on visual design or UI polish, but not the UX or research side.

  • You’ve only worked on incremental improvements and never designed new flows or features.

  • You’ve only worked on marketing sites or mobile apps and haven’t designed complex systems.

  • Location: London (hybrid — 3 days/week in-office). Candidates must have the right to work in the UK; we're unable to offer visa sponsorship.

Why Raft?

Supply chain is the last great industry to be transformed by software. We're here to make it happen — and we need people who grab problems, not assignments.

  • We're a multicultural team building something unprecedented. We work with the clarity and urgency of a team that knows what's at stake.

If you care about impact and want your work to shape the future of AI supply chain — you'll thrive here.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer / Head of Technology (m/w/d)
jobs.company_name: Nationales Herz-Netz (NHN) / Deutsche Gesellschaft für Kardiologie e. V.
jobs.description:
Wer wir sind

Wir sind das Nationale Herz-Netz, kurz NHN – eine neu gegründete gemeinnützige GmbH (gGmbH) mit Sitz in Düsseldorf und 100-%ige Tochter der Deutschen Gesellschaft für Kardiologie (DGK).

Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen sind in Deutschland die häufigste Todesursache und sie verursachen mit 64 Milliarden Euro jährlich immense Kosten im Gesundheitssystem. Es wird also schnell klar: Intensive Forschung an Behandlungsoptionen rettet Leben und spart Geld. Umso erstaunlicher ist, dass die Dokumentation einer Behandlung an der Kliniktür endet. Das behandelnde Krankenhaus hat keinerlei Informationen darüber, wie es den Patienten nach der Behandlung ergeht, weiß also nicht, ob die Behandlung erfolgreich oder überflüssig war. Das sieht nur die Hausärzte oder die Kardiologen vor Ort. Ein Datenaustausch findet nicht statt.

Unser Ziel ist es, diese Lücke zu schließen: Wir bauen das erste bundesweite digitale Register für Herz-Kreislauf-Behandlungen auf: Das heißt: alle Informationen an einem Ort. Das ist jetzt möglich, weil wir mit modernster KI-Technologie in Kombination mit medizinischer Spitzenkompetenz in der Lage sind, unterschiedlichste Datenquellen zu vereinheitlichen. Durch das NHN können Ärzte erkennen, wie Therapien unter realen Bedingungen wirken – und Behandlungen dorthin lenken, wo sie tatsächlich den größten Nutzen bringen, sodass Menschen mit Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen eine messbar bessere Versorgung erhalten und länger und mit höherer Lebensqualität leben können.

Wir stehen ganz am Anfang. Du steigst zu dem Zeitpunkt ein, an dem noch alles gestaltet wird – die Prozesse, die Kultur, das Wie unserer Arbeit. Was heute entsteht, wird die deutsche Herzmedizin für viele Jahre mitprägen – und Du kannst dabei sein.

Aufgaben

Du baust die technische Plattform des NHN, rekrutierst und führst das Tech-Team.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Datenplattform, bestehend aus Backend und Frontend.
  • Du baust die KI-gestützte Extraktion auf, also die Pipelines, die aus unstrukturierten klinischen Dokumenten strukturierte medizinische Daten machen. OCR, NLP und moderne Sprachmodelle gehören dazu, ebenso die Prüfung und Freigabe durch medizinisches Personal. An der Qualität dieser Pipeline entscheidet sich der Erfolg des gesamten Vorhabens.
  • Du sorgst für Interoperabilität, indem Du konsequent auf Standards wie FHIR, HL7 und IHE setzt. So bleiben unsere Daten national wie international anschlussfähig.
  • Du denkst Datenschutz und Sicherheit von Beginn an mit: Privacy by Design, Pseudonymisierung über eine unabhängige Treuhandstelle und die Vorbereitung auf ISO 27001. Die regulatorische Verantwortung trägt unser Head of Legal, mit dem Du eng zusammenarbeitest.
  • Du triffst pragmatische Technologieentscheidungen mit Blick auf Robustheit, Auditierbarkeit und Tempo. Dabei weißt Du, welche Weichen später teuer zu stellen sind und welche man ohne Risiko wieder ändern kann.
  • Du baust das Team auf, zuerst die ersten Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler und ML-Engineers, dann die Struktur dahinter. Externe Partner bindest Du dort ein, wo sie uns schneller machen, ohne dass wir die Kernkomponenten aus der Hand geben.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast komplexe Datenplattformen entworfen und skaliert, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen oder in einem anderen stark regulierten Umfeld wie FinTech oder Cybersecurity.
  • Du arbeitest ausgesprochen hands-on: Cloud-native Softwareentwicklung und moderne Web-Technologien liegen Dir ebenso wie ML-Entwicklung und MLOps bis hin zum Finetuning großer Transformer-Modelle.
  • Du hast schon einmal etwas von Grund auf gebaut, ohne bestehende Plattform und ohne großes Team im Rücken.
  • Du verbindest technische Vision mit pragmatischer Umsetzung und priorisierst eine Roadmap so, dass früh etwas Lauffähiges existiert.
  • Kenntnisse von Interoperabilitätsstandards und medizinischen Terminologien sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Die medizinische Fachlichkeit kommt aus unserem ärztlichen Team.
  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, agile Teams aufzubauen und die Balance zwischen eigener Entwicklung und externen Partnern zu halten.
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse mit, denn unsere Partner sind deutsche Kliniken.
  • Du willst mit Technologie einen gesellschaftlichen Beitrag leisten.

Benefits

  • Arbeit mit echtem gesellschaftlichen Mehrwert: Die Technologie, die Du baust, soll in zwei Jahren in über 60 Kliniken produktiv laufen. Wir treten an, um einen Beitrag zu einem besseren Gesundheitswesen zu leisten, nicht um für Anteilseigner Rendite zu erwirtschaften.
  • Sicheres Umfeld, gesicherte Finanzierung: Als Tochter der Deutschen Gesellschaft für Kardiologie (DGK) stehen wir auf einem verlässlichen Fundament. Unsere Finanzierung ist langfristig gesichert. Du bekommst die Aufbaudynamik einer jungen Organisation ohne das übliche Start-up-Risiko.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum und Perspektive: Du verantwortest die technische Architektur von Beginn an und baust den Bereich auf. Die Rolle ist so angelegt, dass sie mit dem NHN und mit Dir wächst.
  • Faire Bezahlung: Eine angemessene, marktübliche Vergütung, die Deiner Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht.
  • Ein modernes, gut erreichbares Büro in Düsseldorf – mit kurzen Wegen, flachen Hierarchien und einem wertschätzenden Miteinander in einem kleinen Team. Mobiles Arbeiten ist möglich; regelmäßige Präsenz bei Partnern und Stakeholdern in Deutschland wird erwartet.
  • Vollzeitstelle, Beginn nach Absprache, gerne zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt.

Deine Bewerbung

Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen zu Deiner Motivation.

We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next.

  • Growth Mindset: You approach challenges as opportunities to learn, and raise the bar for the people around you.

  • Craft Leadership: You consistently translate complex, nuanced product challenges into simple, intuitive user flows — without sacrificing depth or business logic.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Customer Success
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Success to lead our UKI team within the Large and High Growth segment. Joining our Customer Experience department, you will be responsible for executing our regional CS strategy, driving team performance, and ensuring an exceptional experience for our most strategic UKI customers.

In this role, you will directly manage, coach, and scale a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs). Your mission is to operationalise our customer success motions, ensuring your team successfully drives product adoption, value realisation, retention, and expansion across their portfolios.

This role is ideal for an experienced B2B SaaS or Fintech people leader who thrives in fast-paced environments. You should bring a strong execution discipline, a commercial mindset, and a passion for frontline coaching to help your team turn complex customer challenges into simple, impactful solutions.

 

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director, Customer Success (large and high growth) and leading a dedicated regional team of CSMs. The team is highly collaborative and dedicated to retain the largest customers of Pleo. You’ll also have the chance to work closely with UKI commercial team, account managers, customer support, onboarding, product and RevOps to ensure customer risk is addressed early and growth opportunities are maximised

 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Manager of Customer Success, you will:

  • Lead and coach a team of 10 CSMs, providing active coaching, career development, and daily operational guidance to ensure consistent, high-quality performance.

  • Own your team’s core metrics.

  • Implement and iterate on segment-specific success plans, engagement motions, renewal readiness playbooks, and risk-mitigation strategies.

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to ensure seamless customer transitions, aligned account strategies, and coordinated execution during renewals and expansion plays.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for UKI strategic accounts, working cross-functionally with Product, Support, and Operations to eliminate friction points.

  • Use operational insights, data dashboards, and forecasting metrics to track team productivity, evaluate portfolio health, and proactively address churn risks.

Immediate priorities you can expect to tackle:

  • Strengthening localised account health visibility and proactive risk intervention.

  • Building high-impact execution habits across your team of 10 CSMs.

  • Improving renewal readiness and commercial handoffs with the UKI Sales teams.

  • Fostering a culture of accountability, continuous feedback, and performance excellence.

 

What You Bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, with a proven track record of 2+ years directly managing high-performing teams in B2B SaaS, fintech, or fast-paced technology environments.

  • Strong experience supporting large, mid-market, or enterprise-level accounts with complex stakeholders and sophisticated commercial needs.

  • A strong commercial acumen - you seamlessly connect day-to-day customer health to retention, expansion, and long-term business value.

  • Deep familiarity with Customer Success methodologies, customer lifecycles, health scoring, and risk mitigation tools.

  • Excellent people leadership skills with a proven ability to hire, inspire, hold accountable, and develop talent.

  • A data-driven approach, comfortable utilising CRM and CS tooling (e.g.Hubspot, Vitally) to drive team performance and forecasting.

  • Fluency in English with exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Other languages are a plus

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience in fintech, spend management, payments, or financial operations verticals.

  • Experience scaling team structures from smaller cohorts to larger regional pods.

 

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love combining frontline coaching with commercial strategy

  • You thrive in high-velocity, evolving environment

  • You want to make a highly visible, regional impact

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer a steady, predictable corporate routine

  • You want to step away from the frontline

  • You view Customer Success as purely “customer happiness"

 

How You’ll Develop in this Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Establish a highly cohesive, high-performing UKI CS team structure for our CSMs.

  • Deliver measurable improvements in UKI customer retention, renewal execution, and expansion pipelines.

  • Build a deep understanding of our product ecosystem to successfully advocate for the needs of our UKI market.

  • Be recognized as a vital execution partner to our Director of CS and a champion for our large and high-growth customer base.

 

Location

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

 

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 mins interview with the hiring manager to deep dive into your experience and what you can bring to the team

  3. Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take-home test to showcase your onboarding strategy and data driven approach and invite you to a 60 mins team interview to present your challenge and to know part of the team

  4. Final Interview: Final conversation with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Manager, Customer Success, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Highlight the most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the Team

The Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team at Airwallex is a strategically vital function operating under a clear Three Lines of Defence model. As the independent second line, FCC owns the global AML/CTF programme, sanctions framework, risk assessment methodology, and governance infrastructure across all global entities. As Airwallex scales into new markets and deepens its engagement with global regulatory bodies, we are building a world-class compliance organization capable of managing complex financial crime risks at scale. This is an environment where you will tackle high-impact challenges, shape global fintech risk strategies, and help establish foundations for long-term growth.

What you'll do

As Manager, FCC Monitoring & Testing, EMEA you will shape and scale Airwallex’s global financial crime compliance monitoring and testing framework, establishing a rigorous, data-driven second-line assurance function. You will independently validate the design and operating effectiveness of AML, Sanctions, and KYC/KYB controls across all production environments and establish a monitoring framework and associated metrics to support executive decisioning and ongoing maintenance of program and control operating effectiveness. You will work closely with the broader FCC organization, Product, Engineering, Operations, and regional leadership to turn testing insights into operational accountability, robust remediation, and a defensible compliance posture before global regulators and institutional banking partners.

This role covers the APAC region (excluding China and Hong Kong) and is based in Singapore. In this role, you will be a key part of a global team, collaborating closely across regions to drive consistent FCC Monitoring & Testing standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the strategic development, execution, and continuous evolution of Airwallex’s Global FCC Monitoring & Testing Programme, establishing robust, risk-based testing methodologies and annual plans for independent second-line assurance.

  • Design comprehensive testing frameworks to validate core compliance controls across customer onboarding, periodic reviews, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and regulatory reporting workflows, ensuring coverage keeps pace with product and market expansion.

  • Oversee the ongoing FCC monitoring program for APAC (excluding China and Hong Kong), including establishment of KPIs and operating effectiveness metrics.

  • Advance the transition from traditional sample reviews toward continuous, data-enabled assurance by leveraging data analytics, system logs, and automated testing scripts to evaluate compliance control performance at the population level.

  • Oversee the independent validation of system-encoded controls, including transaction monitoring thresholds, screening logic, and customer risk-rating models, ensuring systems function as intended without logic drift or hidden control gaps.

  • Translate complex testing outcomes and thematic trends into clear, decision-useful reporting for executive leadership and governance forums, providing constructive challenge to stakeholders and tracking the root-cause remediation of control deficiencies.

  • Represent the FCC monitoring and testing function during regulatory examinations, internal or external audits, and banking partner reviews, confidently defending testing methodologies and control evidence.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

jobs.title: Senior Integrated Campaign Manager
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

About the Role:

DeepL's translation portfolio is trusted by well over 20,000 companies and hundreds of millions of professionals worldwide. Rather than organizing our go-to-market by product line, we run a single integrated campaign that speaks to the different people who drive adoption of that portfolio organized by persona, not by feature set. As Integrated Campaigns Manager, you will own the persona motion targeting Global Operators, the department heads in Marketing, HR, and Learning & Development who are responsible for how their organizations communicate globally. Other campaign owners run the parallel motions for personas like Product, Engineering, and Developers; your job is to build the strategy, narrative, and channel mix for the Global Operators audience specifically.

This role sits at the intersection of integrated marketing, demand generation, and account-based marketing. You will start from how Marketing, HR, and L&D leaders think, communicate, and buy, then shape DeepL's capabilities into narratives and programs that speak directly to their priorities. You will orchestrate multi-channel campaigns from concept to launch, and partner closely with Product Marketing, SDR, and Field Marketing to bring targeted, personalized programs to personas in our highest-value accounts.. You will report to the Director of Performance Marketing and Campaigns and work cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content, Creative, Regional Marketing, and RevOps..

What You'll Own:

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Translate DeepL's translation capabilities into compelling, pipeline-driving campaigns tailored to how functional leaders operate and buy, educating the market on the value of AI-powered translation for global business communication.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Field, Performance, and SDR teams to develop go-to-market programs and nurture streams aligned with persona priorities and regional needs.

  • Collaborate with Content, Creative, and Regional Marketing teams to produce and localize campaign assets.

  • Maintain a global campaign calendar and asset library, ensuring brand consistency, messaging alignment, and timely deployment across all touchpoints, and coordinate with owners of other persona tracks (e.g., Product/Eng/Dev) so the portfolio campaign reads as one coherent motion.

Account-Based Marketing (ABM)

  • Collaborate with the rest of the team to design and execute ABM programs, building tailored campaign strategies, messaging, and content for prioritized accounts and account tiers.

  • Partner with Performance Marketing and RevOps to feed account engagement, pipeline influence, and conversion data back into ABM targeting and strategy decisions.

  • Continuously refine account segmentation and messaging based on engagement signals, win/loss insights, and sales feedback.

.Measurement & Optimization

  • Drive measurable impact on awareness, adoption, and pipeline; setting and tracking KPIs such as lead quality, conversion rates, account engagement, and ROI.

  • Collaborate with Performance Marketers to initiate data-driven optimization and A/B testing across campaign channels and ABM plays to continuously improve performance.

  • Leverage insights and competitive intelligence to inform campaign strategy, refine positioning, and identify new opportunities in the AI translation market.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Foster cross-functional collaboration and campaign excellence, sharing learnings, best practices, and post-mortem analyses to continually improve performance and scalability.

  • Serve as the campaigns subject matter expert, representing campaign and ABM performance in relevant leadership and planning forums.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, campaign management, demand generation, or ABM roles.

  • Proven track record of managing complex, multi-channel campaigns from strategy through execution.

  • Understanding account-based marketing programs, including account tiering, personalized content, and multi-touch orchestration alongside Sales.

  • Demonstrated success driving pipeline generation and revenue growth through integrated and account-based campaigns.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and meet deadlines.

  • Data-driven decision-making and proficiency in campaign analytics, attribution, and performance optimization.

  • Excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management, particularly with Sales and SDR teams.

  • AI literacy, including familiarity with GenAI tools for campaign planning, content creation, and execution.

  • Preferred: previous experience in high-growth SaaS companies (Series B–IPO stage).

  • Preferred: experience with ABM platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) in addition to core marketing tech.

Technical Requirements - nice to have:

  • Marketing Automation: HubSpot

  • CRM: Salesforce (or equivalent)

  • ABM Platform: 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks, or similar (preferred)

  • Project Management: Asana, Jira, or similar tools

  • Content Management: Contentful or comparable CMS/DAM platforms

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (B2B SaaS Startup)
jobs.description:
Unsere Mission

Gestalte mit uns den globalen Handel neu – in einem schnell wachsenden Startup!
Wir sind traide AI – ein VC-finanziertes B2B-Deep-Tech-Startup aus Berlin. Mit KI lösen wir eine der am meisten unterschätzten und zugleich kritischsten Herausforderungen im internationalen Handel: die Zollkonformität. Unsere Software automatisiert die Produktklassifizierung, reduziert regulatorische Fehler und hilft Kund:innen, bis zu 83 % ihrer Zeit zu sparen.
Marken wie BMW, Koro und Jack Wolfskin vertrauen uns bereits. In den letzten 12 Monaten sind wir 4x gewachsen – und wir fangen gerade erst an.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Verantworte den kompletten Loop. Bring ein User-Problem von der groben Idee bis zum ausgelieferten Interface: Brief schreiben, Flow designen, prototypen und shippen, mit so wenigen Übergaben wie möglich.
  • Nutze KI als Kraftverstärker. Explore und prototype mit KI-Tools, Figma oder Code, was auch immer am schnellsten zum Ziel führt. Dein Geschmack ist die entscheidende Ebene: Du erkennst, wenn KI-generiertes UI falsch ist, auch wenn es richtig aussieht, und du korrigierst es.
  • Löse vom ersten Prinzip aus. Denk über die richtige Interaktion für das User-Problem nach, statt zur Komponenten-Bibliothek zu greifen.
  • Kümmere dich um die letzten 10 %. Die Details, die andere übersehen, machen ein Compliance-Produkt vertrauenswürdig.
  • Arbeite in kleinen, fokussierten Pods. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen, kein Warten. Du arbeitest eng mit zwei oder drei Leuten, die dasselbe Modell teilen.
  • Sei an Ergebnissen messbar. Kenn die Metrik, die dein Team bewegt. Miss deine Woche daran, was sich für User verändert hat, nicht an gelieferten Screens.
  • Geh über Design hinaus. Lies die API-Spec, sprich direkt mit Usern, bau in Code, wenn das schneller ist als Figma.


Nach wem wir suchen

Handwerkliche Design-Qualität ist hier die Basis, kein Bonus. Was dich auszeichnet, sind Bandbreite und Urteilsvermögen: Du weißt, wie „great" aussieht, du merkst, wenn etwas richtig aussieht, sich aber falsch anfühlt, und du bringst ein Team dorthin.

  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (C1 oder besser) sind Voraussetzung. Deutsch ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Echtes Design-Handwerk mit Track Record: Du hast Interfaces geshippt, die echte User ohne Erklärung bedienen konnten, und du kannst die Metrik nennen, die sich dadurch bewegt hat.
  • Starkes visuelles Gespür, hohe Ansprüche und ein Auge fürs Detail.
  • Bandbreite über Design, Product und Engineering: Du bist von einem User-Problem zum testbaren Prototyp gekommen, ohne auf einen Brief zu warten, und hast mit KI-Coding-Tools etwas Echtes gebaut. Du bist nicht auf eine:n Engineer angewiesen, um deine Vision umzusetzen.
  • Du hast persönliche KI-Workflows aufgebaut, die dich spürbar schneller machen, und weißt, wann du KI-Output vertraust, editierst oder verwirfst.
  • Du fühlst dich in Ambiguität wohl: Du shippst, sammelst Signale und iterierst, statt auf volle Klarheit zu warten.
  • Du kannst deine Arbeit zeigen (Portfolio oder Beispiele).
  • Idealerweise hast du an Produkten gearbeitet, bei denen Fehler echte Konsequenzen haben (Fintech, Healthtech, Logistik, Compliance), das ist aber kein Muss.
  • Du bist in Berlin oder bereit umzuziehen.
Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn…
  • Du willst, dass ein PM das Problem definiert und ein:e Engineer die Lösung baut.
  • Du dich sträubst, mit Code oder KI zu arbeiten.
  • Du polierte Figma-Files übergibst und deinen Job für erledigt hältst.
  • Du dich nur an deinem Geschmack misst, nicht an Ergebnissen.


Warum wir?

Was dich erwartet

  • Abwechslung im Alltag → jedes Problem bringt eigene Anforderungen mit, kein Tag ist wie der andere
  • Sichtbarer Impact → du siehst die direkten Resultate deiner Arbeit, für unsere Kund:innen und für traide AI
  • Direkter Einfluss aufs Produkt → deine Entscheidungen gehen live und prägen, was User täglich nutzen
  • Team-Kultur → ein Team, das transparent kommuniziert, Humor schätzt und sich mit Respekt und Aufrichtigkeit unterstützt
  • Flexibles Arbeiten → wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro am Senefelderplatz in Berlin Prenzlauer Berg/Mitte. Homeoffice ist an zwei Tagen pro Woche möglich
  • Sei Teil unserer regelmäßigen Team-Events (Bootstouren, Bowling etc.)
  • Profitiere von Benefits wie einer Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next.


TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team

  • Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact)

  • Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer

  • Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success


ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are successful if you:

  • Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces.

  • Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution.

  • Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts.

  • Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability.

  • Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness, and performance as fundamental pillars of your craft.

  • Provide mentorship to the team, sharing expertise in research methodologies and design principles.

  • Refine the visual and functional identity of WunderGraph through meticulous and high-impact design work.

  • Impact high-level product strategy by demonstrating how user-focused decisions drive tangible business impact.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Product Design

  • Design and prototype user flows, interfaces, and interactions with scalability in mind.

  • Own design problems end to end. From initial concept through execution and iteration after launch.

  • Rapidly produce wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, exploring multiple concepts and iterating quickly.

  • Define and evolve our design system and component library, keeping it consistent and maintainable.

  • Partner closely with engineers on feasibility, quality, and handoff, contributing to technical decisions (and coding where you're comfortable and it helps as a plus, not a requirement).

  • Introduce advanced prototyping, interaction design, and motion practices.

UX Research & Strategy

  • Plan and conduct user research across discovery and validation via user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitor analysis.

  • Turn ambiguous product questions into decision-grade research that maps to real product and design decisions.

  • Synthesize findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and opportunity areas that the team can act on.

  • Build and maintain a shared insight repository so learning is reusable, searchable, and available to everyone.

  • Translate research into an informed, evolving UX strategy that guides the roadmap and anchors design direction in real user needs.

  • Advocate for the user in prioritization and roadmap discussions, and define what "better" looks like through clear UX success metrics.

  • Run discovery workshops and share insights so research shows up where decisions are made like in design reviews, product planning, and standups embedding user knowledge from the get-go.

Web & Brand Experience

  • Own the design and evolution of WunderGraph's web presence.

  • Deliver assets that span product and marketing: landing pages, visuals, campaign graphics, and interactive components.

  • Shape and maintain a cohesive style guide, balancing design innovation with consistency.

  • Support brand storytelling with motion graphics and interactive elements.


ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • Senior-level experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a strong portfolio of shipped work.

  • Proven experience planning and running UX research (both generative and evaluative) and turning findings into strategy.

  • Proficiency in Figma, prototyping tools, and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Strong background in UX and interaction design, accessibility, responsive design, and usability.

  • Experience contributing to or leading design systems and component libraries.

  • Comfortable using data and research to inform and defend design decisions.

  • Working knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript a plus) enough to collaborate closely with engineers.

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and collaboration skills in English.

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and can lead initiatives independently in a fast-moving startup.

  • Comfortable working 100% remotely in a distributed team.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for team retreats and workshops.






Why WunderGraph?

  • Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

  • You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us

  • Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge

  • Competitive compensation

  • Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards

  • Team retreats across the globe

Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.

The Process

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

  • 30 min intro call with Mariya from our People team

  • 45 min discussion with the hiring manager. Following this, you might receive a small take home assignment related to the role. This is your chance to prove your skill!

  • Complete the assignment and review together with hiring manager

  • Meet the founders

  • Culture fit call with team members

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

WunderGraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources

Frontier is an independent video game developer and publisher, crafting immersive gaming experiences with fun gameplay and unparalleled artistic quality. Renowned for its iconic creative management simulation games, Frontier captivates players worldwide with immersive and authentic game worlds. The modern studio is located in the vibrant technology hub of Cambridge (UK). The talented team at Frontier are dedicated to nurturing our existing portfolio and delivering our exciting future roadmap. 
 
This role is offered on a full in-studio basis or a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days per week in the studio). We can provide a comprehensive relocation support package as part of any offer, should you need to relocate. 

WHAT'S THE ROLE?

We are looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to join our Planet Coaster 2 team and play an important role in delivering quality experiences to our players. Joining an established and diverse team, you will bring experience, expertise, curiosity and energy to the development of our games.  You will program primarily in C++ working with our in-house Cobra engine and cross-platform game code.

As part of our development team, you will have a fantastic opportunity to apply, expand and share your expertise in modern game development techniques, and help push the boundaries of the current generation of gaming platforms. You will be collaborating with a talented team of programmers working on game features alongside specialists across multiple disciplines. You will also collaborate with game designers and QA testers on tuning the player experience.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of the team behind our multi‑million‑selling, cross‑platform titles and help us continue delivering exceptional gaming experiences to our players.    


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
  • Architecting and developing game features and systems.
  • Collaborating effectively with team members and discipline leads.
  • Designing and implementing technology using structured, efficient, maintainable, and well‑documented code. 
  • Considering the impact of systems on other disciplines and projects, ensuring usability, scalability, and support for long-term maintenance.
  • Guiding more junior programmers and providing feedback on their code, documentation and approach to game development.
  • Creating and maintaining project wide documentation for more complex systems, features and workflows. 
  • Participating in, contributing to, and occasionally leading aspects of project reviews and meetings, as required.

    • WHAT YOU'LL BRING
    • A track record in the development of complex game features in released titles.  
    • Excellent problem solving and programming skills using modern C++.
    • Experience working in a large codebase with the ability to adapt to established methods.
    • Proficient profiling and optimisation skills for CPU performance and memory usage.
    • Experience of cross-discipline collaboration with game designers and content creators.
    • A genuine passion for video games.
    • A desire to be part of a world class team and contribute to its continued success.
    • A proactive approach to collaborative learning and knowledge sharing with colleagues.
    • A drive to expand your existing expertise in game development, and a passion for continued learning and self-improvement.

    BONUS IF YOU HAVE
    • Experience working with a proprietary game engine.

    • Experience managing or mentoring other programmers to support their growth.
    • Cross-platform development experience on shipped titles, including consoles (Xbox, PlayStation, etc.).
    • Working knowledge of an entity component system.

    WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU

    You will work with talented and passionate people to support, develop or publish our sophisticated and enduring games, in a creative, collaborative and inclusive environment. We love what we do, and we work hard to provide outstanding experiences for our players. 

    Wellbeing is a big focus at Frontier, and we are continually evolving how we can support our people. We encourage a healthy work/life balance and provide a range of wellbeing activities, initiatives and sessions to support both mental and physical health.
