Want to join a team of passionate people who want to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer?

👋 About us

Skin Analytics is an award-winning, health tech company that deploys world-leading skin cancer pathways using AI as a medical device, DERM.

Following our recent £15M series B funding, regulatory milestones hit, and doubling from 50 to 100 headcount in 2025, we're ready to scale further internationally, making history for AI in healthcare and the future of dermatology.

We're proud to epitomise AI for good - with a Class III CE mark, DERM is the only AI as a medical device approved to make clinical decisions autonomously in the cancer space, as well as being the first company to receive a NICE recommendation for use across the NHS.*

DERM is deployed at more than 28 NHS organisations where we enable patients to gain significantly quicker access to skin cancer diagnosis. If that's not enough, we also collaborate with some of the largest health insurers to reach patients in their own homes.

We are a team of passionate people on a mission to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer.

Brief overview
This role owns the messaging architecture that underpins everything the marketing function produces. Builds and maintains the positioning and messaging platform that makes the company's strategic transition commercially effective across multiple products, markets, and audiences. Operating in close partnership with Product and commercial leadership, the output will directly impact how products are understood and adopted at a system and national level.

Responsibilities

Messaging and Positioning

  • Builds and maintains the core messaging framework across DERM audience platforms. Defines positioning, value proposition, proof points, and claims by product, audience and market

  • NHS strategic narrative: Develop the positioning for product transitions, and future lifecycle stages, articulating a clinically credible and scalable adoption pathway. Defines how Skin Analytics differentiates from competitors and makes the case for systemic adoption in primary and secondary care.

  • Defines the strategic positioning and competitive differentiation for international expansion in partnership with commercial leadership. Sets the foundation the PMM executes against.

  • Define and build Market entry positioning for priority International markets, accounting for differences in healthcare system structure, clinical procurement culture, and regulatory context in each geography

Claims Governance

  • Build and maintain the claims library in conjunction with Medical Director / Research teams. Define the process and governance for adding, updating, and retiring claims, ensuring the team can produce compliant content at speedy sign-off.

  • Works with Clinical and Innovation teams to understand forthcoming clinical evidence and ensures marketing positioning is built to leverage it.

Sales Enablement

  • Develops the Sales Enablement Framework for commercial teams: battle cards, pitch decks, case study briefs, objection handling, and market-specific materials.

  • Ensures the PMM delivers the sales enablement content, and it is built, stored, and tracked so commercial teams have a single, current resource base and adoption can be actively measured.

  • Run structured win/loss analysis and translate findings into updated messaging, positioning, and enablement materials with clear commercial accountability for outcomes

Go-to-Market

  • Owns the go-to-market process for new products (launch playbooks) and product updates.

  • Briefs the Marketing Manager on digital content requirements based on messaging framework, ensuring campaign execution is consistent across all channels

Accountable for

  • Win rate and sales cycle length, improvement attributed to sales enablement quality

  • Claims library completeness and adoption rate by team

  • Launch readiness, integrated with product team to ensure products launched with complete messaging and enablement on time

  • Commercial team satisfaction with PMM output, measured through regular and structured feedback

Required Experience

  • Demonstrated track record developing and owning positioning and messaging frameworks for complex B2B products in a multi-market, multi-audience environment. Healthcare, medtech, or clinical SaaS experience is strongly preferred.

  • Proven ability to design and synthesise market, customer, and competitive intelligence into positioning that differentiates the product. Previous evidence that intelligence directly shaped positioning decisions and commercial differentiation.

  • Experience running structured win/loss analysis and ability to translate findings into updated messaging and sales enablement with measurable commercial impact.

  • Experience working between product, commercial, and marketing teams to translate product capability into commercially compelling narratives.

  • End to end GTM ownership across the full launch lifecycle: strategy, goal setting, cross functional alignment, execution, measurement, and post-launch review.

  • Evidence of managing conflicting priorities and tensions across different functions and products.

  • Proficient with HubSpot reporting and attribution tools to measure the commercial impact of PMM output: win rates, deal velocity, and enablement adoption rates. (or equivalent experience on Salesforce)

  • AI Literacy Actively uses AI tools as part of day-to-day workflow: competitive intelligence synthesis, market research, positioning iteration, and sales enablement development.

  • Comfortable with prompt engineering for efficient content and research tasks; able to produce high-quality, on-brand materials at pace using AI tooling.

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary

📈 Share options package - all our employees have ownership in the company

🏥 Private healthcare

💸 Company pension incl. salary sacrifice options

🌴 25 days annual leave + 5 day company shutdown in August + bank holidays

👪 Enhanced parental leave - includes adoption & foster

🐣 Yellownest Salary Sacrifice Nursery Scheme - save with workplace nursery scheme

🚲 Bike to work scheme

💻 Training budget

🤝 Weekly catch-ups, monthly meetings to talk about you, your ambitions and work on your development

🎊 Lots of fun social activities!

Our Values

🌱 Building a Strong Foundation

🎓 Always Learning

🏅 Lead from the Front

💪 Tough and Resilient

The Real Stuff

Skin Analytics embraces and is committed to diversity and equal opportunities. We are dedicated to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. If you need any adjustments during our hiring process, you can indicate that at the next step.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Specialist Voice | DACH
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

About DeepL Voice

DeepL Voice is shaping the future of real-time multilingual communication.

Built on DeepL’s world-leading translation quality, the Voice product line brings together Research, Engineering, Product, and GTM teams to deliver real-time speech-to-speech interpretation for meetings, live conversations, and developer integrations.

In just two years, DeepL Voice has launched its first customer-facing products and built reliable, low-latency real-time systems. We are now scaling globally—expanding adoption, opening new use cases, and defining a new product category in multilingual communication.

The Role

As a Senior Sales Specialist (Voice Product Evangelist), you will help bring DeepL Voice to market at scale.

This is a customer-facing GTM role focused on supporting sales teams across the DACH region, leading Voice-specific customer conversations, and helping organisations understand and adopt real-time translation. You will work closely with Core Account Executives, Product, and Marketing to shape how Voice is positioned, demonstrated, and sold.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Account Executives on Voice-related opportunities across enterprise customers

  • Lead Voice-specific discovery, demos, pilots, and customer presentations

  • Act as a subject-matter expert across DeepL Voice use cases (meetings, live conversations, APIs)

  • Support the creation and evolution of Voice sales materials, talk tracks, and playbooks

  • Enable sales teams through training sessions, deal support, and hands-on guidance

  • Represent DeepL Voice in customer meetings, workshops, and strategic engagements

  • Gather customer and field feedback to inform product positioning and roadmap discussions

What You Bring

  • 6–10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, in an Account Executive or Specialist Sales role

  • Experience selling complex or emerging products that require customer education

  • Strong presentation and communication skills with both technical and business audiences

  • Ability to clearly articulate product value and real-world use cases

  • Comfort working cross-functionally in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

  • Experience selling Voice-related technology, such as Conversational AI, Real-Time Systems, or Communication technologies (Contact Centre, CCaaS, Unified Comms) plus API solution experience

  • Fluency in English and German

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-JW2

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: Online Marketing Trainee (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Hallo!

Wir sind Klickkonzept. Eine datengetriebene, KI-orientierte Online-Marketing-Agentur im Herzen von Frankfurt. Als Teil der internationalen Cosmo5-Gruppe betreuen wir großartige Marken aus E-Commerce, Luxus, Beauty und B2B. Was uns besonders macht? Echte Leidenschaft, eine offene Kultur und die Überzeugung, dass jeder Einzelne bei uns Großes bewirken kann.

Du stehst am Anfang deiner Karriere im digitalen Marketing und hast keine Lust auf Kaffee kochen oder monotone Dateneingabe? Du willst tief in die Mechanik von Google, Amazon, Meta & Co. eintauchen und verstehen, wie Unternehmen heute online wirklich Geld verdienen – von der Suchanzeige über den Social Feed bis zum KI-Chatbot, der Kaufentscheidungen prägt? Dann bist du hier genau richtig.

Unser Versprechen: Vom Anfänger zum Strategie-Designer

Wir suchen keine fertigen Experten. Wir suchen smarte, analytische Köpfe mit dem unbedingten Willen zu lernen. In unserem Trainee-Programm bilden wir dich zum sogenannten „T-Shaped Marketer" aus. Was das heißt? Gemeinsam wählen wir deinen vertikalen Schwerpunkt – deine Spezialdisziplin, in der du echte Tiefe aufbaust:

  • Paid Search (SEA) - bezahlte Sichtbarkeit in Google & Co.
  • Paid Social - Performance-Kampagnen auf Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn & Co.
  • Amazon Ads / Retail Media - Werbung dort, wo gekauft wird
  • SEO & GEO - organische Sichtbarkeit in klassischen Suchmaschinen und in KI-Antwortsystemen wie ChatGPT, Gemini oder Google AI Overviews

Das ist der vertikale Strich im „T". Gleichzeitig bringen wir dir bei, wie das gesamte digitale Marketing-Ökosystem zusammenspielt (der horizontale Strich) – denn die spannendsten Ergebnisse entstehen genau dort, wo die Kanäle ineinandergreifen. Du lernst nicht nur, wie man Knöpfe in Werbekonten oder Tools drückt. Wir machen dich zum strategischen Berater, der versteht, wie messbarer Impact und echter Umsatz für Unternehmen generiert werden.

Aufgaben

Deine Lernkurve (Das erwartet dich):

  • Das Handwerk lernen: Du lernst von der Pike auf, wie Kampagnen und Maßnahmen in deiner Spezialdisziplin aufgebaut, umgesetzt und optimiert werden - ob Paid-Kampagnen, Amazon-Werbung oder SEO/GEO-Maßnahmen.
  • Operative Exzellenz: Recherche und Analyse, das Verfassen psychologisch cleverer Texte und Creatives, Zielgruppen- und Keyword-Definitionen sowie das Erstellen aussagekräftiger Performance-Reports werden zu deiner täglichen Routine.
  • Analytisches Arbeiten: Du unterstützt unsere erfahrenen Account Manager bei Marktforschungen und Analysen. Du lernst, wie man Rohdaten interpretiert und in strategische Empfehlungen für den Kunden übersetzt.
  • Verantwortung übernehmen: Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung wirst du Tag für Tag und Woche für Woche mehr lernen und eigene Schwerpunkte in deinen Kundenprojekten setzen.
  • KI verstehen: Du bekommst Einblicke in unser „AI Lab" und lernst, wie moderne Marketer Künstliche Intelligenz nutzen, um ihre tägliche Arbeit effizienter zu gestalten - und wie sich Sichtbarkeit im Zeitalter von generativer Suche neu definiert.

Qualifikation

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium (BWL, Marketing, Medienwissenschaften o.ä.) oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung - aber viel wichtiger ist uns dein Mindset!

  • Du hast ein Faible für Zahlen. Daten schrecken dich nicht ab, sie wecken deine Neugier.
  • Du hast ein gutes Auge fürs Detail, arbeitest strukturiert und verlierst auch bei komplexen Aufgaben nicht den Überblick.
  • Du hast Lust auf eine steile Lernkurve, nimmst Feedback als Chance zum Wachstum und bringst dich proaktiv ins Team ein.
  • Du hast idealerweise schon eine Idee, in welche Richtung es für dich gehen könnte - oder Lust, das gemeinsam mit uns herauszufinden.
  • Erste Praktika oder Berührungspunkte im digitalen Marketing sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Deutsch fließend und sicheres Englisch.

Benefits

  • Mentoring & Training: Du nimmst an zahlreichen internen und externen Schulungen teil. Erfahrene Kollegen stehen dir permanent als Mentoren zur Seite.
  • Fokus-Squads & Teamspirit: Wir arbeiten in agilen, 6–7-köpfigen Fokus-Squads direkt an unseren Kunden. Das bedeutet für dich: kurze Wege, ein intensives Teamgefühl und gemeinsamer Erfolg, den ihr als Einheit feiert.
  • Agenturleben, das Spaß macht: Eine harmonische Zusammenarbeit, flache Hierarchien und Kollegen, die sich gegenseitig pushen. Dazu Teamevents, kostenlose Getränke und Snacks.
  • Flexibilität: Auch als Trainee genießt du bei uns flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice.
  • Internationale Luft: Durch unser Netzwerk von 28 Partnerbüros arbeitest du in einem wirklich globalen Umfeld.
  • Die Perspektive: Unser klares Ziel ist es, dich nach erfolgreichem Abschluss deines Traineeships als festen Junior Manager in deiner Spezialdisziplin in unser Team zu übernehmen.

Bist du bereit für diese Herausforderung?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Ein klassisches Anschreiben ist kein Muss – zeig uns in deinem Lebenslauf oder in ein paar persönlichen Zeilen, warum du für das digitale Marketing brennst und warum Zahlen deine besten Freunde sind. Verrate uns dabei gern, welche Disziplin dich am meisten reizt (oder ob du dich bewusst noch nicht festlegen willst).

Bei uns zählt Vielfalt. Wir leben Inklusion, Respekt und Chancengleichheit.

Du hast Freude daran, Kunden ganzheitlich zu begleiten – von der ersten Implementierung bis zum langfristigen Erfolg? Du kannst an einem unserer deutschen Standorte oder deutschlandweit remote aus dem Homeoffice arbeiten.

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrungen in der technischen Fehleranalyse gesammelt und kannst bestehende Code-Strukturen nachvollziehen, um Fehlerursachen einzugrenzen.

Senior Strategy & Operations Manager

 

As the S&O Lead for Monetisation, you will be responsible for managing and optimising merchant monetisation strategy across our markets. We are looking for a highly driven Strategy and Operations Leader to take ownership of key monetisation levers and help build scalable systems, tools, and processes. You’ll be part of the Merchant Strategy & Operations (S&O) team and report into the Director, Global Mx Strategy.

You’ll work closely with senior stakeholders, commercial leadership, product teams, and finance to design, implement, and iterate on monetisation strategies. This role is both strategic and executional, ideal for someone who thrives on solving complex commercial problems while rolling up their sleeves to drive impact.

 
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Define our monetisation strategy, collaborating with commercial leadership across global markets to set our global framework for commission, fee structures and our overall take rate. Lead monetisation pilots, track performance, and scale successful models across markets.

  • Drive standardisation and reduce complexity across markets and segments, whilst maintaining a clear understanding of different competitive and market landscapes across markets and how those should impact our decision.

  • Operationalise strategy and build playbooks, guidelines and negotiation frameworks to empower commercial and account management teams to land monetisation changes successfully.

  • Define the monetisation roadmap with Engineering and Product leads, using technical solutions and automation to create processes that are effective and efficient.

  • Serve as the global DRI (Directly Responsible Individual) for merchant monetisation, pushing the business to think about wider market trends and competitive pricing benchmarking.

  • Assemble, inspire and drive a cross-functional team of stakeholders for monetisation that helps you drive strategic decisions as well as day to day running of governance and processes.

  • Own ambitious monetisation OKRs and create the governance and structures to track performance, course correct and prioritise.

  • Set and maintain high standards of operational rigour, ensuring monetisation frameworks are scalable to all markets and segments, and compliant with local regulations.

 

About You

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience (preferably a mix of strategy consulting and business operations) in tech, marketplaces, or B2B monetisation.

  • Commercial Acumen: Deep understanding of marketplace dynamics, subscription pricing, or complex B2B financial models.

  • Analytical Mindset: Strong data-driven approach with proficiency in data and visualization tools to solve complex commercial problems.

Why Join Us?

 

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

Working Student - Product Engineer

Over 4 million merchants use our card readers to process payments in 34 countries. As we build a world where every business can thrive, we continually expand our range of products and services. We are a truly global fintech company, with 3,000+ people from 93 nationalities spread across 22 offices on four continents.

As the People Tech team, our mission is to enable long-term scalability by fostering a data-informed culture through seamless systems and a people-centric employee experience. As our Product Engineer - Working Student, your first mission will be to help us rethink Feedback and Team Reviews: learn how the process works today, find the friction and turn promising ideas into product experiences that colleagues can test.

The work starts frontend-first: build realistic prototypes in React, Next.js or similar and explore a simpler product layer over Workday, our system of record. If a direction proves valuable, you may help grow it into a standalone internal app - from interface and APIs to data models, authentication and integrations - alongside People Tech and engineering partners.

This is a real product challenge, not a side quest: you will learn across discovery, UX, frontend, testing and product decisions, supported by mentorship and code review. You will collaborate with Product Owners, process owners, people tech and workday specialists, sumuppers, managers, people partners, people analytics and senior stakeholders, with potential exposure to backend development, integrations and production delivery. If your favourite way to answer "what if?" is to build it, you will fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Find the right problem: Speak with process owners, employees and managers to understand Feedback and Team Reviews, identify friction and decide what is worth solving first.
  • Shape a focused product slice: Turn requirements, questions and constraints into clear user journeys and an MVP that can teach us something useful.
  • Prototype and iterate quickly: Build realistic frontend experiences in React, Next.js or similar; compare directions, test assumptions and adjust when the evidence points somewhere better.
  • Design for different kinds of work:  Create accessible, intuitive flows for office-based teams, metrics-driven Field Sales colleagues and on-site teams without building three separate products.
  • Think end to end:  If the concept is validated, help evolve it towards a standalone app while considering APIs, data, authentication, privacy, deployment, integrations and what should remain in Workday.
  • Use AI as a co-pilot, not an alibi:  Use tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, v0, Lovable or similar to accelerate development while still understanding, checking and owning the result.
  • Make the learning visible: Demo your work, explain decisions and trade-offs, respond to feedback and document the findings and technical choices that should shape the next version.

You'll be great for this role if

  • Student status. You are currently enrolled at a university and available for a part-time role based in Berlin.
  • Modern web development skills. You have built web applications with React, Next.js or a similar frontend framework. Coursework, internships, hackathons, personal projects and portfolio work all count.
  • Product-minded builder. You care about the user's goal and accessibility, and can turn an ambiguous problem into the simplest useful solution, test it and iterate.
  • Full-stack and AI curiosity. You want to learn how APIs, data and services turn an interface into a reliable product, and can use AI-assisted tools while still understanding, checking and owning the result.
  • Clear, team-first communication. You can explain what you built end to end, make technical choices understandable, ask for input and respond well to feedback.

Nice to have

  • Backend and integration foundations. Some experience with Node.js, TypeScript, Python, databases, APIs, serverless functions, Supabase, Firebase, AWS or comparable technologies.
  • Identity and data concepts. A basic understanding of OAuth, SSO, permissions or responsible data handling.
  • What we don't expect: years of professional experience, previous Workday knowledge or a perfect first attempt. If you do not tick every box, please apply anyway and show us what you can build, how you think and how you learn.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

This is a pure new business role. You own a defined territory and named-account set, the pipeline you create within it, and the commercial outcome of every deal you run, from first conversation to signature.

  • Commercial negotiation that builds value and protects price rather than defaulting to discount.

Land and Expand

  • First wins scoped so they can grow: sites, countries and use cases sequenced from the start.

  • A clean handover to Customer Success, with the expansion path documented.

Forecasting and Governance

  • A forecast that holds, with stage integrity, next steps and close dates you stand behind.

  • Contribution to the playbook i.e. objections, competitive intelligence and repeatable use cases.

Commercial outcomes

  • New-logo ARR against quota

  • Pipeline creation and territory coverage

  • Win rate, against incumbents and against no decision

  • Average deal value and total multi-year value

  • Strategic logos won

Operating standards

  • Forecast accuracy and stage integrity

  • Multi-threading and MEDDICC quality

  • Price protection and discount discipline

  • CRM quality and process discipline

Your First 12 Months

  • First 90 days: complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage and create the first qualified opportunities.

  • By six months: credible coverage against ramped quota, multi-threaded opportunities progressing through evaluation, and a first customer win closed or materially advanced.

Package, Support and Progression

This role is for an accomplished new business seller who wants the autonomy to build a territory, the support to win complex enterprise deals and real reward for over-performance. If you have created pipeline, won meaningful customers and run a disciplined process, we would like to hear from you.

About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.
 
Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab.


Functions of the Role

As Director of Systems Delivery, you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. 

You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments.

We are seeking a pragmatic leader with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams to deploy first-of-a-kind, deep-tech systems into field environments. Direct hardware experience in silicon, semiconductor, or advanced physical instrumentation is mandatory; you must understand physical build constraints, microelectronics/systems integration, and environmental facility requirements.

  • Full-Stack System Execution: Lead the Systems Delivery capability to execute internal full-stack system deployments, bridging physical hardware with full-stack software from assembly through customer handover.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate across hardware, software, product, and operations teams to align physical hardware build schedules with software release cycles, managing dependency interfaces and trade-offs.

  • Site Infrastructure Readiness: Oversee internal and customer site infrastructure preparation to ensure physical environments are ready for deployment.

  • Acceptance Testing & Governance: Implement delivery schedules, risk management, and formal acceptance testing protocols.

  • Service & Operational Handoff: Establish post-installation support frameworks, handovers, and field engineering processes to guarantee long-term operational uptime.

  • Process Standardisation: Build scalable playbooks, quality standards, and repeatable processes for integration, validation, and operational readiness. 

  • Supply Chain Management: Manage technical hardware procurement, key vendor relationships, and supplier performance supporting delivery timelines.                                                                  

  • Commercial Scoping Support: Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability.


Experience - Essentials

  • Must have proven experience managing physical hardware systems (e.g., quantum, semiconductor, aerospace, or advanced scientific instrumentation) with a realistic understanding of physical build constraints and lead times.

  • Demonstrated background managing hardware-software integration, physical systems validation, and site-installation constraints.

  • Experience building, managing, and mentoring hardware, systems integration, or field delivery teams.

  • Track record of taking first-of-a-kind physical hardware platforms from prototype to repeatable deployment models.

  • Hands-on experience managing facility readiness and running structured customer acceptance protocols.

  • Strong project management expertise tracking HW/SW critical paths, project budgets, risk registers, and executive reporting.

  • Direct experience overseeing technical vendors, supplier selection, and component procurement.

  • Strong communication skills with key stakeholders, including executive, technical, and customer audiences. Willingness and eligibility to travel internationally to customer sites as required.


Experience - Desirable

  • Direct technical background in quantum computing systems, cryogenic systems, silicon platforms, or HPC architectures.

  • Experience establishing post-delivery field support, service handoffs, or customer support operations for complex hardware.

  • Experience scaling system assembly and delivery operations within a deep-tech environment. Experience supporting hardware/software technical scoping for commercial proposals.

jobs.title: VP/Head of Engineering (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Volle technische Verantwortung für Rocket — direkt an die Gründer, ohne Zwischenebene

tack von Marriott. Unsere Engineers arbeiten also mitten im echten Hotelbetrieb, nicht gegen Sandbox-APIs.

In dieser Rolle verantwortest du Engineering bei MICE DESK — vollständig. Es gibt keine CTO-Ebene über dir: Architektur, Technik, Delivery und Team liegen bei dir, und du berichtest direkt an die Gründer. Das ist eine Hands-on-Führungsrolle. Du führst das Engineering-Team inklusive unserer AI-/Data-Funktion, verantwortest die Schnittstelle zu Product und stehst für alles gerade, was ausgeliefert wird.


  • Engineering, end-to-end. Architektur, System-Design, Delivery gegen die Roadmap, Zuverlässigkeit, technische Schuld. Backend, Frontend, DevOps, QA und das AI-/Data-Team laufen bei dir zusammen. Du setzt schlanke Prozesse, mit denen ein kleines Team schnell liefert, ohne Dinge zu zerbrechen.
  • Eine AI-gestützte Engineering-Pipeline. Wir bauen nicht nur AI-Produkte — wir bauen mit AI. Du machst die Engineering-Organisation selbst AI-nativ: agentische Coding-Workflows, AI-gestützte Reviews und Tests, Automatisierung von allem Wiederkehrenden. Ein kleines Team soll liefern wie ein dreimal so großes — das wahr zu machen ist dein Job.
  • AI als Kernfähigkeit des Systems. Du architektierst die Integration von LLMs und agentischen Workflows in Produktivsysteme: deterministische Logik kombiniert mit AI-generierten Ergebnissen, mit echter Validierung, Fallbacks und Zuverlässigkeitsstrategien. Der Hotelbetrieb läuft auf unserer Plattform — Nicht-Determinismus ist keine Entschuldigung für Unzuverlässigkeit.
  • Das Team. Einstellen, entwickeln, skalieren. Du übernimmst ein starkes kleines Team und machst daraus eine leistungsstarke Engineering-Organisation mit einer Kultur aus Ownership und Tempo. Auch unsere verteilte Hiring-Strategie über mehrere Standorte hinweg liegt bei dir.
  • Product- und Business-Alignment. Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und Product. Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, vereinfachst Komplexität und verbindest Engineering-Arbeit mit Ergebnissen: Umsatz, Automatisierung, Kundenwirkung. Mit dem US-Markteintritt muss Engineering mit Enterprise-Kunden auf zwei Kontinenten Schritt halten.

Woran wir Erfolg messen:

  • 6 Monate: Delivery ist planbar, die AI-gestützte Dev-Pipeline läuft, und das Team ist um A-Player gewachsen, die du eingestellt hast.
  • 12 Monate: Die Plattform skaliert mit US-Enterprise-Kunden, die Kernsysteme sind zuverlässig und observierbar, und Engineering ist ein Wettbewerbsvorteil — kein Flaschenhals.

Ehrlich gesagt: Das ist volle Verantwortung ohne Netz darüber. Keine CTO-Ebene, die Entscheidungen abnimmt oder abfängt — die Architektur, das Team und alles, was ausgeliefert wird, sind deins. Wenn du eine Rolle suchst, in der jemand über dir die Richtung vorgibt, ist das nicht deine Stelle. Wenn du genau diese Verantwortung willst, ist es die richtige.


Dein Profil

  • 10+ Jahre Software Engineering, davon 5+ in einer Engineering-Führungsrolle in wachstumsstarken Produktunternehmen.
  • Starker Hands-on-Hintergrund in Backend oder Full-Stack — du kannst noch selbst in die Tiefe gehen.
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung, Engineering-Teams in wachsenden Startups zu skalieren.
  • Starke Architektur-Expertise: APIs, verteilte Systeme, Event-Driven Design, Cloud.
  • LLM-/agentische AI-Systeme in Produktion — und eine echte Überzeugung, dass Engineering selbst AI-gestützt gehört.
  • Product-Mindset: Du verbindest technische Entscheidungen mit geschäftlichen Ergebnissen.
  • Souverän im Umgang mit Ambiguität, Tempo und voller Verantwortung.

Ein Pluspunkt, kein Muss: Hintergrund in Hospitality-Tech, CRM, PMS oder Revenue Management. Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Integrationen (Salesforce, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Microsoft Graph API). Erfahrung in der Führung verteilter, internationaler Teams.


Warum wir?

Wir sind das Technologieunternehmen, das den Gruppen- und Veranstaltungsverkauf in der Hotellerie neu denkt. Was heute über Posteingang, Excel und Telefon läuft, macht unsere Plattform Rocket zu einem durchgängigen, KI-gestützten Prozess — von der ersten Anfrage bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag. Europäische Hotelgruppen führen ihren Gruppenverkauf bereits darüber.
Das bedeutet für dich: Du arbeitest nicht trotz KI, sondern mit ihr. Wer bei uns anfängt, gibt Feedback, das in Produktentscheidungen einfließt — und versteht irgendwann, warum ein Prompt besser funktioniert als ein anderer.
Und weil wir schnell wachsen, ist vieles bei uns noch im Entstehen. Manche Antwort lautet ehrlicherweise „das bauen wir gerade noch”. Genau darin liegt die Chance: Du triffst auf Freiräume statt auf fertige Strukturen, und was du hier aufbaust, trägt deine Handschrift.

Was wir bieten

  • Arbeit mit echter KI-Technologie auf internationalem Niveau — nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Geschäftsmodell.
  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum. Deine Ideen landen nicht in einem Ideenbriefkasten, sondern in der nächsten Iteration.
  • Kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen in Tagen, nicht in Gremienschleifen.
  • Wachstum, das du mitgehst. Wir bauen gerade die nächste Unternehmensphase — mit Rollen, Verantwortung und Perspektiven, die es vor einem Jahr noch nicht gab.
  • Hauptarbeitsort Leipzig mit regelmäßiger Büropräsenz und flexiblem Homeoffice-Anteil. Hybride Modelle sind bei uns gelebte Praxis, nicht die Ausnahme.
  • Unbefristeter Vertrag, Vollzeit.
  • Leistungsprämien für nachweisbare Erfolge.
  • Mehrtägige Teamevents an Orten, die tatsächlich Spaß machen.
So läuft unser Bewerbungsprozess
  1. Intro-Interview — wir lernen uns kennen, du erfährst, wo wir stehen und wohin wir wollen.
  2. Leadership Study oder Technical Study, je nach Rolle — ein echtes Problem aus unserem Alltag, das wir gemeinsam durchgehen.
  3. Founder Interview

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is at an inflection point in its growth, and this is a rare opportunity to shape how the world's most accurate AI translation company engages enterprise customers, creates pipeline and scales through partners globally. As Director of Global Field & Partner Marketing, you will own two tightly integrated functions: a global field and events programme spanning owned, third-party and executive formats, and a partner marketing capability that activates DeepL's growing ecosystem of channel, technology and integration partners.

You will lead a distributed team of regional field marketers and partner marketers across EMEA, APJ (dotted line) and North America, unifying them under a single commercial strategy that is directly accountable to pipeline creation, deal acceleration, adoption and expansion revenue.

This role reports directly to the VP of Demand Generation and sits at the heart of DeepL's go-to-market motion.

Your responsibilities

GLOBAL FIELD MARKETING & EVENTS

  • Own and scale DeepL's global field marketing programme across owned events, third-party conference activations, executive engagement formats and digital programmes - driving net new pipeline, deal acceleration and product adoption across mid-market and enterprise segments.

  • Define and manage the global field marketing strategy, ensuring programme investment is allocated to the highest-return formats and markets and adjusted in response to pipeline signals and sales priorities.

  • Lead the evolution of DeepL's flagship owned programme portfolio scaling them across new cities and regions while maintaining quality, commercial rigour and local relevance.

  • Build and scale an executive engagement capability in close partnership with Sales and Customer Success, creating access to senior decision-makers within priority accounts through intimate, high-value formats.

  • Partner with Sales, SDR, Revenue Intelligence and Marketing Ops to establish rigorous measurement frameworks covering pipeline sourced, pipeline influenced, speed-to-lead and closed-won attribution - and use these insights to drive continuous programme optimisation.

  • Champion a culture of commercial accountability: every programme format is evaluated against pipeline outcomes, and investment decisions are made on evidence, not habit.

PARTNER MARKETING

  • Lead DeepL's partner marketing function, developing and executing co-marketing strategies with channel partners, technology partners, GSIs, ISVs and integration partners that generate measurable pipeline and expand DeepL's market reach.

  • Build scalable co-marketing frameworks - including joint event programmes, partner-led demand generation, marketplace activations and partner enablement content - that allow partners to market DeepL effectively within their own networks and customer bases.

  • Own partner-attached pipeline targets and contribution to ARR, ensuring partner marketing programmes are designed to drive measurable commercial outcomes rather than activity metrics.

  • Partner closely with the Partnerships, Sales, Product Marketing and Creative Studio teams to develop partner-specific messaging, assets and campaign frameworks that reflect DeepL's positioning while enabling partner customisation.

  • Develop and manage the partner marketing calendar globally, with clear accountability for joint pipeline targets, co-investment frameworks and performance reporting.

  • Continuously evolve the partner marketing operating model to support DeepL's growing partner ecosystem, including emerging opportunities with hyperscalers, marketplace listings and developer community programmes.

LEADERSHIP & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

  • Lead, inspire and develop a high-performing, globally distributed team of field marketers and partner marketers, fostering a culture of commercial accountability, creativity and continuous improvement.

  • Serve as the key marketing partner to Sales, SDR, Customer Success, Product Marketing and Partnerships leadership - aligning field and partner activity directly to pipeline targets, territory plans and revenue objectives.

  • Represent field and partner marketing at senior leadership level, clearly articulating strategy, programme performance, investment rationale and regional market insights.

  • Build and maintain strong operating cadences with Sales leadership across all regions, ensuring tight alignment on target account lists, programme priorities and follow-up execution.

Qualities we look for

  • 12–15 years of experience in field marketing, events and/or partner marketing, with significant time spent in B2B SaaS — ideally within a global scale-up of 500+ employees.

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling owned event programmes - including executive engagement series, flagship conferences and multi-city roadshows - with direct accountability for sourced and influenced pipeline outcomes.

  • Proven track record in partner marketing, including co-marketing programme design, partner enablement and partner-attached pipeline generation across channel, technology and GSI partner ecosystems.

  • Strong AI literacy, with hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to scale field marketing operations, automate campaign execution workflows and improve programme ROI - including use cases across event setup automation, content personalisation, lead scoring and follow-up cadence management.

  • Proven ability to embed AI into field marketing operating models, driving efficiency gains, faster execution cycles and improved pipeline outcomes.

  • Experience leading and developing a geographically distributed team of 6+ marketers across multiple regions, with a track record of building strong team cultures and developing regional marketers into senior contributors.

  • Deep familiarity with the enterprise B2B buying cycle - including the interplay between field-sourced pipeline, SDR follow-up, sales acceleration and partner-influenced revenue.

  • Exceptional commercial instincts: you are comfortable owning pipeline targets, interpreting SFDC attribution data and using programme performance insights to influence investment decisions at the leadership level.

  • Strong cross-functional instincts - you are a natural collaborator who can align Sales, Partnerships, SDR and Product Marketing around shared field and partner priorities without formal authority.

  • Excellent programme management capabilities, with the ability to maintain clarity and momentum across a complex global event calendar, multiple partner co-marketing initiatives and a distributed team operating across time zones.

  • A practical, proactive mindset: you balance strategic programme design with genuine willingness to be in the detail when it matters - from reviewing a post-event attribution report to being on the ground at a flagship event.

Genieße ein modernes Office mit modernster technischer Ausstattung, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell – inklusive der Möglichkeit, aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten. Zusätzlich zum bezahlten Urlaub bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit eines Sabbaticals, weil Deine Freizeit uns am Herzen liegt.


YOUR IMPACT

Als Werkstudent:in Field Marketing & Events DACH unterstützt du unser Field-Marketing-Team bei operativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben rund um Kampagnen, Events, Datenmanagement und die Lokalisierung von Marketinginhalten. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Head of Field Marketing, Events & Experiences sowie den Field Marketing Manager:innen für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz zusammen und erhältst direkte Einblicke in die Arbeitsweise eines internationalen SaaS-Marketingteams.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Planung und Durchführung von Events – von Versand und Logistik über Teilnehmermanagement bis hin zum Aufbau vor Ort und der Nachbereitung – und begleitest Veranstaltungen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz.

  • Du koordinierst Webinare, unterstützt bei Probeläufen, optimierst Präsentationen (auch mit KI-Unterstützung) und betreust Live-Fragerunden.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem zentralen Performance-Marketing-Team zusammen, koordinierst Marketingmaterialien und unterstützt die Umsetzung regionaler Kampagnen.

  • Du lokalisierst Marketinginhalte für den DACH-Markt, prüfst Übersetzungen, optimierst Vorlagen und nutzt KI-gestützte Übersetzungstools, um eine konsistente Markenkommunikation sicherzustellen.

  • Du analysierst Marketingdaten aus Salesforce, HubSpot und weiteren Plattformen, aktualisierst Reportings und unterstützt das Team dabei, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

  • Du beobachtest Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen sowie regulatorische Trends, nutzt bei Bedarf KI-gestützte Zusammenfassungen und bringst deine Erkenntnisse in die Marketingplanung ein.

Werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte und unterstütze uns auf unserem Weg, führender Anbieter digitaler Compliance- und Governance-Lösungen zu werden.


THIS IS YOU

  • Du bist aktuell in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudium eingeschrieben, idealerweise im Bereich Marketing, Betriebswirtschaft, Kommunikation oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.

  • Du begeisterst dich für Marketing und Events und möchtest praktische Erfahrungen in einem dynamischen internationalen Umfeld sammeln.

  • Du hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Vertriebsprozesse und weißt, warum qualitativ hochwertige Leads wichtig sind.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher und professionell – schriftlich wie mündlich – und fühlst dich auch bei Präsentationen im kleinen internen Kreis wohl.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und behältst auch bei mehreren Aufgaben den Überblick.

  • Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Zahlen und möchtest lernen, wie datenbasiertes Marketing funktioniert.

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Excel und PowerPoint und interessierst dich für CRM- und Marketing-Automation-Tools wie Salesforce oder HubSpot – alles Weitere bringen wir dir gerne bei.

  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1) in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du wohnst im Raum München oder kannst regelmäßig zu unserem Standort pendeln (hybrides Arbeitsmodell).

  • Du bist bereit, innerhalb Deutschlands sowie nach Österreich und in die Schweiz zu reisen, um Veranstaltungen zu begleiten.

  • Du arbeitest gerne mit internationalen Kolleg:innen zusammen, kommunizierst souverän per E-Mail und Chat und orientierst dich an globalen Prozessen.

Account Executive (m/w/d) – AI Legal Tech | Berlin
jobs.description:
Die Rechtsbranche wird gerade durch KI neu gebaut.

JUPUS baut die erste KI, die bis zu 80 % der Arbeit in Anwaltskanzleien selbstständig erledigt.

In nur drei Jahren ist JUPUS mit über 80 Mitarbeitenden in Köln und Berlin sowie einem international aufgestellten Tech- und Product-Team zu einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Legal-Tech-Unternehmen Europas geworden. Über 2.000 Anwältinnen und Anwälte arbeiten bereits mit JUPUS.

Und wir stehen erst am Anfang.

Deshalb suchen wir Account Executives, die nicht einfach nur Software verkaufen wollen, sondern Lust haben, einen neuen Markt mit aufzubauen, Verantwortung für ihren eigenen Erfolg zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns eine ganze Branche zu verändern.

Was dich bei JUPUS erwartet:

Ein Produkt mit echtem Pain: Du verkaufst keine Nice-to-have-Software, sondern eine Lösung für konkrete Herausforderungen im Arbeitsalltag von Kanzleien.

  • Full-Cycle Sales mit Ownership: Du verantwortest deine Pipeline und deine Deals – von der ersten Opportunity bis zum Closing.

  • AI + perfektes Markt-Timing: Du arbeitest in einem Markt, der gerade fundamental durch neue Technologie verändert wird.

  • High Velocity: Viele Gespräche, schnelle Sales Cycles, klare Targets und die Möglichkeit, unmittelbar Einfluss auf deinen Erfolg zu nehmen.

  • Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest eng mit Sales Leadership, Foundern sowie Product & Tech zusammen.

  • Hohe Standards ohne Ellenbogenkultur: Wir wollen gewinnen – als Team.

  • Schnelle Entwicklung: Wer performt und Verantwortung übernimmt, bekommt bei JUPUS die Möglichkeit, schnell den nächsten Schritt zu gehen.

Was du bei uns machst:

  • Du baust aktiv deine eigene Pipeline auf – über Outbound, Inbound und neue Wege, die du selbst mitentwickelst.

  • Du führst Discovery- und Demo-Gespräche mit Kanzleien und verstehst schnell, wo ihre größten Herausforderungen liegen.

  • Du übersetzt diese Herausforderungen in einen klaren Business Case für JUPUS.

  • Du steuerst deine Opportunities eigenverantwortlich durch den gesamten Sales Cycle bis zum Closing.

  • Du beherrschst Einwandbehandlung, Follow-ups und Verhandlung und weißt, wie aus Interesse ein Abschluss wird.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit SDRs, Marketing und Revenue Operations zusammen.

  • Du bringst deine Erfahrungen und Ideen ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Talk Tracks, Prozesse und unser Sales Playbook weiter.

Wer bei JUPUS erfolgreich wird:

Du musst nicht aus der Rechtsbranche kommen.

Viel wichtiger ist uns, wie du Vertrieb verstehst.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du:

  • gerne verkaufst und Energie daraus ziehst, Deals voranzubringen

  • selbst Chancen schaffst, statt darauf zu warten, dass sie dir jemand gibt

  • nach einem schwierigen Gespräch genauso konsequent weitermachst wie nach einem gewonnenen Deal

  • stark kommunizierst und komplexe Themen schnell auf den Punkt bringen kannst

  • Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und deine Ergebnisse übernimmst

  • direktes Feedback schätzt und dich kontinuierlich verbessern willst

  • Geschwindigkeit und Veränderung als Chance begreifst

  • ambitioniert bist, ohne dafür ein großes Ego zu brauchen

Was du idealerweise mitbringst:

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Sales – idealerweise in SaaS, Tech oder einem vergleichbaren High-Growth-Umfeld

  • Erfahrung im Full-Cycle Sales oder einen starken Track Record im Vertrieb und den klaren Wunsch, vollständige Deal-Verantwortung zu übernehmen

  • Sicherheit in Discovery, Einwandbehandlung und Closing

  • Eine ausgeprägte Outbound-Mentalität und Freude daran, aktiv neue Opportunities zu schaffen

  • Struktur und Konsequenz im Pipeline- und CRM-Management

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Erfahrung mit HubSpot, Salesforce oder vergleichbaren CRM-Systemen ist ein Plus

Warum JUPUS gerade jetzt?

Weil Timing im Vertrieb einen Unterschied macht.

KI verändert gerade ganze Industrien – und der Rechtsmarkt steht dabei noch ganz am Anfang.

JUPUS hat ein Produkt, das bereits von über 2.000 Anwältinnen und Anwälten genutzt wird, einen riesigen adressierbaren Markt und die Ambition, eine der prägenden Plattformen dieser Transformation zu bauen.

Für dich bedeutet das: Du kommst nicht in eine fertige Sales-Organisation, in der du nur ein bestehendes Playbook ausführst.

Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, selbst zu verkaufen, sichtbar zu performen, Strukturen mitzuprägen und mit dem Unternehmen zu wachsen.

Was wir dir bieten:

  • Hybrid-Modell mit 3 Office-Tagen pro Woche

  • Offices in Köln und Berlin

  • Viel Ownership und kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit einem ambitionierten Sales- und Leadership-Team

  • Schnelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – beispielsweise in Richtung Senior AE oder Team Lead

  • Urban Sports Club

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und Offsites

  • Modernes Equipment inklusive MacBook

Du willst verkaufen, Verantwortung übernehmen und dabei sein, wenn ein neuer Markt entsteht?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Senior Consulting Engineer
Product Designer - Core UX
Alliance Director, Strategic Technology Partnerships
jobs.description:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients. 

 

Why us?

🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.

🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.

🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.

💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.

Role Mission:

This role owns the end-to-end management of CUBE's most strategically significant technology partnerships — including large ISVs such as IBM, ServiceNow, and Microsoft. The Alliance Director is responsible for building and deepening commercial relationships, structuring and closing complex partnership agreements, and activating joint go-to-market motions that generate measurable, attributable revenue.

This is not a relationship maintenance role. It requires a commercially sophisticated operator who understands the mechanics of technology ecosystems — OEM, resell, redistribution, co-sell, and technology integration — and who can navigate complex, multi-stakeholder commercial environments to move partnerships from strategic intent to commercial outcome.

Responsibilities:

Commercial Partnership Development

  • Own the full commercial lifecycle of assigned technology partnerships, from structuring and negotiating agreements through to renewal, expansion, and performance management.

  • Lead and close complex partnership agreements, including OEM arrangements, resell and redistribution frameworks, co-sell motions, and joint solution commercialisation.

  • Identify and pursue commercial models that unlock mutual revenue growth, with a clear line of sight to pipeline contribution and partner-influenced revenue.

  • Maintain a deep understanding of each partner's commercial priorities, go-to-market strategy, and internal incentive structures to position CUBE advantageously.

Technical Partnership Depth

  • Develop and maintain a strong working knowledge of how CUBE's technology integrates with partner platforms, and how those integrations create joint value for customers.

  • Engage with technical and product stakeholders — both internally and within partner organisations — to progress integration roadmaps, co-develop joint solutions, and identify new areas of technical collaboration.

  • Evaluate and pursue OEM, embedded, and distribution opportunities that extend CUBE's reach through partner technology stacks.

  • Act as a credible voice in technical discussions, capable of articulating integration architecture, data flows, and platform interoperability at a level that builds confidence with partner product and engineering teams.

Relationship & Stakeholder Management

  • Build and sustain executive-level relationships within partner organisations, establishing CUBE as a preferred and trusted partner.

  • Manage a broad and complex stakeholder map across each partner — spanning alliances, sales, product, legal, and C-suite — and navigate competing priorities to advance CUBE's position.

  • Represent CUBE at partner advisory boards, strategic forums, industry events, and joint customer engagements.

  • Maintain regular cadences with partner leadership, including joint business reviews, executive briefings, and strategic planning sessions.

Go-to-Market Activation

  • Design and execute co-sell programmes with partner field organisations, ensuring CUBE is embedded in partner sales motions and consistently positioned in joint opportunities.

  • Collaborate with CUBE's sales, marketing, and product teams to translate partnership agreements into active pipeline and closed revenue.

  • Drive partner enablement — ensuring partner-facing teams have the knowledge, tools, and incentives to position and sell CUBE effectively.

  • Track and report on pipeline, revenue attribution, and partner engagement metrics, providing regular performance updates to the Global Head of Strategic Partnerships.

Internal Collaboration

  • Work cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Product, and Sales to structure, negotiate, and operationalise partnership agreements.

  • Serve as the internal authority on assigned partner relationships — providing context, intelligence, and strategic guidance to colleagues who interact with or are affected by those partnerships.

  • Contribute to the broader alliance strategy, sharing market intelligence and partnership learnings that inform CUBE's ecosystem approach.

Skills & Experience:

  • Proven track record managing strategic technology partnerships with large ISVs — direct experience with IBM, ServiceNow, or Microsoft ecosystems strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience structuring and closing complex commercial agreements, including OEM arrangements, resell and redistribution frameworks, and technology co-development or integration agreements.

  • Strong working knowledge of technology integration models and the commercial mechanics they enable — how integrations are monetised, productised, and taken to market.

  • Experience designing and executing co-sell programmes with enterprise technology partners, with demonstrable pipeline and revenue results.

  • Track record of building and maintaining executive-level relationships within large, matrixed partner organisations.

  • Commercially sophisticated, with experience managing partner-influenced revenue targets and reporting on portfolio performance to senior leadership.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate cross-functionally in complex organisations — working with Legal, Finance, Product, and Sales to negotiate and operationalise partnerships.

  • Experience in a B2B SaaS, RegTech, FinTech, or enterprise software environment preferred.

Interested?

If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.​

CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: GRC Pre-Sales Consultant / Solutions Engineer – EMEA
jobs.description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Solutions Engineer, you'll serve as a trusted technical voice, guiding customers toward clarity, feasibility, and alignment on the end-to-end solution. Because Vanta is the platform our customers rely on to build and run their GRC programmes, this is a natural next step for GRC professionals, programme managers, auditors, and compliance practitioners who want to apply their domain expertise in a strategic, customer-facing pre-sales role.

You’ll be an integral part of the Sales team, working to ensure technical fit and create innovative solutions for our customers. Your attention to detail, focused on customer needs, will ultimately improve retention and overall success.

This role will be based from our London office or Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

GRC practitioners are especially encouraged to apply—whether you've managed GRC programmes in-house, audited them as an internal or external auditor, or helped customers meet their GRC programme needs at a GRC vendor, you'll bring exactly the customer empathy and domain fluency this role thrives on.

What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer at Vanta:

  • Serve as a strategic sales partner, owning the technical relationship with prospects and customers.

  • Strategic Discovery and Deal Qualification: Partner with Account Executives to uncover technical, operational, and business pain points, validating use cases and aligning solutions to measurable customer impact and urgency.

  • Secure the Solution Win and Alignment: Validate technical feasibility, drive clarity on success criteria, and guide stakeholders toward a shared vision for the end-to-end solution (The Solution Win: Desirable, Viable, and Aligned).

  • High-Impact Technical Validation: Deliver tailored, narrative-driven demonstrations that showcase how Vanta solves the customer's specific problem, including how Vanta automates and operationalises their GRC programmes across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA. Validate the feasibility of standard and semi-complex integrations and confirm alignment with customer environments, workflows, and architectures.

  • Solution Strategy and Deal Shaping: Partner with the Account Executive to align the customer's success criteria with Vanta's unique strengths, proactively surface technical risks, and propose clear pathways to ensure focused deal progression and mutual success.

  • Post-Sale Handoff and Continuity: Ensure a seamless transition to the post-sales team by creating and completing a handoff document that captures the finalised solution design, expectations, and any known risks or constraints.

  • Cross-Functional Feedback: Act as a trusted technical voice, listening carefully to customers to provide structured market feedback to the Product team to prioritise functionality and drive sales opportunities.

  • Support customers throughout their trial process with Vanta.

  • Cultivate an environment of teamwork, openness, creativity, and continuous improvement.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Must be able to work in our London office 3 days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday).

  • Have 5+ years of customer-facing, technical experience as a solutions engineer, sales engineer, GRC consultant, or equivalent customer-facing role, including previous B2B SaaS experience.

  • Strategic Problem Solver: Possess deep technical proficiency to identify and validate technical, operational, and business pain points, driving clarity on solution requirements (Viable Solution Win).

  • Exceptional Communicator: Exhibit outstanding communication, storytelling, and active listening abilities, capable of delivering tailored, high-impact demonstrations that reinforce the sales narrative (Command of the Message).

  • Customer-Centric Advocate: Lead with empathy and curiosity, focusing on strategic discovery to uncover the why and urgency behind customer needs and tying every technical detail to measurable buyer impact (Desirable Solution Win).

  • Collaborative Deal Shaper: Work in lockstep with Account Executives on deal strategy, proactively strengthening qualification and guiding stakeholders toward alignment on a clear delivery path (Aligned Solution Win).

  • Have hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure & Operating Systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux) and cloud application architecture.

  • Be detail-oriented and organised, with strong project management skills.

  • Have general knowledge with a scripting language (Python, Ruby, Bash, and JavaScript) and a desire to expand those skills.

  • Be familiar with REST API development and service integrations is a plus.

  • Ideally have prior experience in the cybersecurity, GRC (governance, risk, and compliance), or audit space.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.
